about: docs/MEDIA.md describes this file. Put each file beside it and list it under its slot.

slots.title: Three Steps
slots.caption: The welcome with no games yet: three checks, one command each, and the dim Final Fantasy shelf below.

slots.title: The Shelf Lights Up
slots.caption: Dropping a file you own into a console folder: its entry on the Final Fantasy shelf lights up by itself.

slots.title: A Classic in Limsa
slots.caption: A game starts in RetroArch on the Linux host and appears as a panel beside the character, then is pinned.

slots.title: Fuzzy Launch
slots.caption: Typing ff7 in the search box, Enter, the save check, the game starting.

slots.title: Saves in Step
slots.caption: The save-sync panel: status, the pairing steps with their copy buttons, a kept conflict.

slots.title: From LaunchBox
slots.caption: A copied LaunchBox library read as it is, with the player's own box art.
